crossRefs.note: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
“How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to…
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

translations.web: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
translations.bsb: “Should this stream of words go unanswered and such a speaker be vindicated?
translations.kjv: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
translations.asv: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?
